channel.title: MBL Insights
channel.description: Toronto missing-middle development — closed rents, costs, financing mechanics.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Build a Sixplex in Toronto? (2026 Numbers)
item.description: Budget $285-300/sf fixed-price for a Toronto sixplex; the deepest repeat crews land $265-285. Full cost stack, scope notes, and why $350-425 retail quotes mislead.

item.title: Toronto Rent Benchmark for Multiplex Underwriting — What Actually Closed (August 2026)
item.description: Closed-lease rent benchmark: 1,846 usable 2026 leases across 18 Toronto districts. Medians and quartiles by pocket and unit type, methodology included.

item.title: What Lot Do You Need for a Sixplex in Toronto? The Frontage Math Nobody Does
item.description: Six-unit use may be permitted, but whether six compliant units fit is lot-specific. The frontage math, worked examples, and the constraints beyond zoning.

item.title: CMHC MLI Select, Explained Like a Human: How Small Builders Get 95% Financing and 50-Year Amortization
item.description: CMHC MLI Select in plain English: the points, the actual energy tiers (20 pts vs 35 pts), why 95% LTC is a ceiling not a promise, and the traps that catch first-timers.

item.title: The $500k Tax Rebate Most Multiplex Builders Don't Know About (Enhanced GST/HST Rental Rebate)
item.description: The enhanced GST/HST rental rebate can approach the full 13% on qualifying new rentals - and the self-supply trap that catches builder-landlords who misfile.

item.title: The 3-Bedroom Premium: Toronto's Most Under-Supplied Rental Unit
item.description: Median 3-bedroom rents run $700-1,600/month above 2-bedrooms across east Toronto pockets, yet floor plans default to 2-beds. The under-supplied unit, quantified.

item.title: Deal Autopsy: Why We Passed on an Entire District
item.description: We measured 54 closed leases, found land worth $500-600k against asks of $819k-1.15M, hit a four-unit zoning cap, and passed on a whole district. The full work.

item.title: How Much Can You Pay for a Toronto Sixplex Lot? The Max-Bid Formula, Worked
item.description: The max-bid formula worked end to end: closed rents to NOI to value to supportable cost to land. Illustrative example, sensitivities, and why most lots fail.

item.title: Why 95% Financing Does Not Mean 5% Cash: The Real Equity a Sixplex Requires
item.description: CMHC MLI Select allows up to 95% LTC - and a Toronto sixplex still needs roughly $500-700k of cash. The timing, eligible costs and coverage math explained honestly.

item.title: CMHC MLI Select for Existing Properties: The Complete Guide
item.description: The complete guide to CMHC MLI Select for existing 5+ unit properties: verified point tables for affordability, energy and accessibility, what 50/70/100 points unlock, and the realistic pathways.

item.title: How to Finance a Toronto Sixplex with CMHC MLI Select
item.description: How a new Toronto sixplex is financed under CMHC MLI Select new construction: the 105-point pathway, verified tier tables, the max-bid chain, cash timing and the lender file.
